dataset.source: Literature verified candidate manifest; HypoBench TRAIN for generation evidence and preserved 501-row TEST manifest for held-out scoring.
dataset.evidence_source: Literature: verified cited-reference abstracts; data: TRAIN text and observed TRAIN labels. Target text, TEST observations/labels and planted hypotheses excluded from generation.
dataset.experimental_unit: One literature target or one fixed TRAIN evidence input set. TEST observations are repeated evaluation items, not generation units.
dataset.task_domain_construction: exact approved fixed task text by testbed in task_text_by_testbed
dataset.canonical_paper_id_rule: Literature arXiv IDs use E6/prepare_dataset.py canonicalize_arxiv_id; HypoBench IDs use dataset_id:split:zero-padded source-row index:canonical source-row SHA-256 prefix.
dataset.arxiv_version_suffix_policy: Strip arXiv vN suffix during canonicalization, as implemented by E6/prepare_dataset.py.
dataset.cross_category_membership_policy: Preserve the union of observed E2 category/pool memberships when canonicalizing duplicate paper IDs; do not create duplicate experimental units.
dataset.sampling_method: 20 disjoint SHA256-ranked TRAIN sets of 20; existing hash-ranked 100 literature targets; seed 2026; no strata
dataset.development_evaluation_split: DEVELOPMENT IDs reserved; literature EVALUATION; HypoBench TRAIN generation and TEST-only held-out scoring.
dataset.data_sampling_status: approved: 20 disjoint TRAIN sets of 20; TEST evaluation only; seed 2026

task_text_by_testbed.data: Given a tweet, determine the likely voting preference of the person for the 2028 U.S. presidential election. The classification should consider whether the individual is likely to vote for the Democratic candidate, the Republican candidate, a third-party candidate, or abstain from voting. The analysis should take into account explicit endorsements, political ideology, sentiment toward candidates and policies, use of partisan language, engagement with political topics, and references to past voting behavior. Additionally, indirect indicators such as reactions to major political events, stance on key social and economic issues, and alignment with party-affiliated hashtags or slogans should be factored into the prediction. The classification should aim to capture both strong political affiliations and nuanced, context-dependent voting tendencies.
task_text_by_testbed.literature: Generate research questions and hypotheses supported by the supplied scientific evidence.

dataset.sample_size_interpretation: 120 independent input sets total, reported separately by testbed; never a pooled metric
dataset.source_freeze_scope: approved TRAIN generation evidence proposal, preserved TEST evaluation manifest, 100-paper selected literature manifest, and Decision20 limited corpus; exact file hashes bound; no scoring/review completion implied

deduplication.duplicate_clustering_rule: complete_link_candidate_generation_order_v1; candidate joins the earliest cluster only when duplicate=true against every member; first member represents cluster.
deduplication.adjudication_rule: Use the fixed-prompt Boolean pair decisions; require all 15 unique pairs exactly once; malformed/missing pair decisions fail the selection preparation, with no second judge or inferred repair.
deduplication.fewer_than_three_unique_questions_policy: Block QH-sel and QH-rand as insufficient-question failures; do not synthesize questions, force merges, or silently replace candidates.

qh_sel.score_scale_and_anchors: Integer 1-5 per dimension; higher values indicate stronger performance on that dimension as stated in prompts/e6/12_qh_sel_ranking.txt.
qh_sel.selector_model_or_method: Prompted ranking using the same injected generator model client used by the arm runner, as implemented in E6/orchestrator.py.

d_empty.evidence_removal_representation: Omit abstract and reference_evidence fields, as configured in E6/question_pipeline_config.json.

d_shuffled.interpretation: data swap tests evidence-draw sensitivity within the same mechanism; no guaranteed negative effect

inference_budget.estimand: Workflow performance under a common generated-token budget per input-set and arm; prompt tokens recorded separately.
inference_budget.budget_policy: One generated-token cap for each arm; intermediate questions, discarded candidates, deduplication, ranking and retries debit their participating arm; shared preparation debits both selection arms. Prompt usage is recorded separately.
inference_budget.per_call_accounting_method: exact backend output-token counts; intermediate, discarded, shared and retry/preflight generation charged per approved arm scope; prompt tokens separately retained; evaluation-only calls outside generation cap
